name: The Ember of the First Hearth

notes: At 30% HP the storm comes down the chimney: Flare becomes lightning and every lightning hit can spread through water, even the water of the Tidewater Urn. Think twice before tipping it.

passives.name: Unyielding
passives.text: Immune to crowd control: Stun, Slow, Silence and Frozen do not take hold, taunts do not force its attacks, and it cannot be pulled or pushed. Other ailments last 1 turn less.

passives.text: At 30% HP Flare turns to lightning. Water on the board conducts it too, Tidewater Urn included.
